Mixed watch, nods to the cargo team
It was a good run
Steady paws, steady skies

This week brought a reassuring mix of routine checks, kind handoffs, and small wins across the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Travelers appreciated the calm support at each step, and the team kept communication clear, warm, and focused on comfort. <<FACT F017>> Staff also noted how well the lounge flow held up, with attention to rest, water, and gentle handling helping every journey feel less hurried.

We also heard good feedback from the Vellmar side, where <<FACT F002>> The shared lesson was simple: when everyone stays alert and speaks plainly, animals and travelers feel more settled. That steady approach keeps the service reliable, and it reminds us that careful work always matters.
